title: kithctl watch: read_exact hangs if server sends fewer bytes than Content-Length claims
description: watch.rs:535-539: when Content-Length is present, jmap_post allocates buf to exactly Content-Length bytes and calls read_exact. If the server closes the connection after sending fewer bytes, read_exact blocks indefinitely — there is no read timeout after TCP connection establishment. The watch loop hangs permanently. Fix: use read_to_limit with a timeout or read with a deadline.
